title: Sign disagreement and variance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $f:\Omega\to\{-1,1\}$. If $X$ and $Y$ are independent samples from $\pi$, then $\mathbb{P}(f(X)\ne f(Y))=\frac12\mathbb{E}_{X\sim\pi}\bigl[(f(X)-\mathbb{E}_{Z\sim\pi}f(Z))^2\bigr]$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function on the sample space
